description: "Graph-based clustering is a popular method for clustering single-cell RNA-seq data. It is based on the idea of constructing a graph from the data, where each cell is represented as a node and edges are drawn between nodes that are similar to each other. The graph is then partitioned into clusters using algorithms such as Louvain or Leiden."
